date.as_written: harinmṛgāṃkayāṃjhava (!) veda pramite vatsare bhādrapadameva ka caturddaśyāṃ śauriyasrānvitāyāṃ

notes: The chronogram for the year is corrupt ('harinmṛgāṃkayāṃjhava (!) veda pramite vatsare'); the cataloguer reads it as SAM 1845 (VS 1845 = 1788 CE). The scribe's title/epithet 'vipaśvit' is misread as a personal name ('Pipaśvī') in the catalogue record. The location description following the scribe's name ('śrīddhariddharesiru (!) rāṣṭrasya vyapāla vāhinīpariveṣṭite') is corrupt and obscure.
